question_en: In American Tower's Q3 2023 10-Q, what does it say about redeeming its 2023 senior notes early, and which of those notes are euro-denominated?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 3 năm 2023 của American Tower, công ty nói gì về việc mua lại sớm các trái phiếu senior notes phát hành năm 2023, và những trái phiếu nào được phát hành bằng đồng euro?
reference_answer: American Tower may redeem the 2023 Notes at any time, in whole or in part, at 100% of principal plus a make-whole premium and accrued interest; no make-whole premium is required if it redeems on or after the par call date. The 4.125% Notes and the 4.625% Notes are denominated in EUR.
evidence_quotes: (2) We may redeem the 2023 Notes at any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price equal to 100% of the principal amount of the 2023 Notes plus a make-whole premium, together with accrued interest to the redemption date.
(3) The 4.125% Notes and the 4.625% Notes are denominated in EUR; dollar amounts represent the aggregate principal amount at the issuance date.

(2) The Company may redeem the 2023 Notes at any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price equal to 100% of the principal amount of the 2023 Notes plus a make-whole premium, together with accrued interest to the redemption date.
If the Company redeems the 2023 Notes on or after the par call date, the Company will not be required to pay a make-whole premium.

question_en: What is the State of Texas accusing Sherwin-Williams' Garland facility of, according to the Q1 2026 10-Q?
question_vi: Theo báo cáo 10-Q quý 1 năm 2026, bang Texas cáo buộc nhà máy Garland của Sherwin-Williams về điều gì?
reference_answer: The State of Texas, through its Attorney General on behalf of the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality, alleges that past operations at the Garland, Texas facility of subsidiary SWM violated Texas environmental regulations on air and water emissions, including events related to the August 8, 2023 fire; SWM denies the violations.
evidence_quotes: The Petition alleges that one of SWM’s Garland, Texas facility’s past operations violated Texas environmental regulations related to air and water emissions, and includes events related to the fire experienced at that facility on August 8, 2023.
SWM denies the violations and claims for relief as alleged

reference_answer: SKIP: the fiscal 2023 passage is a chunk that ends after Use of Estimates (the fiscal 2024 chunk is longer and cut mid-sentence), so the apparent addition of Revenue Recognition is a chunk-boundary artifact, not a real change between the two 10-Ks.

question_en: How did Arthur J. Gallagher's Q3 2024 10-Q describe what its deferred compensation trusts did with company stock, compared with the Q3 2023 10-Q?
question_vi: Báo cáo 10-Q quý 3 năm 2024 của Arthur J. Gallagher mô tả các quỹ ủy thác bồi thường trả chậm đã làm gì với cổ phiếu công ty, so với báo cáo 10-Q quý 3 năm 2023 thì khác thế nào?
reference_answer: The Q3 2023 10-Q only states that Gallagher may contribute cash to the trust and instruct the trustee to buy a specified number of its shares on the open market or in private transactions. The Q3 2024 10-Q adds that in the third quarter of 2024 it instructed the trustee to reinvest dividends on shares held by the trusts and to buy shares using cash contributed to the DCPP for 2024 awards.
evidence_quotes: Under the terms of the DEPP and the DCPP, we may contribute cash to the trust and instruct the trustee to acquire a specified number of shares of our common stock on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions.

In the third quarter of 2024, we instructed the trustee for the DEPP and the DCPP to reinvest dividends on shares of our common stock held by these trusts and to purchase our common stock using cash that we contributed to the DCPP related to 2024 awards under the DCPP.

question_en: Why did DLR's total operating costs shrink in Q1 2023 versus Q1 2022, and by how much?
question_vi: Vì sao tổng chi phí hoạt động của DLR giảm trong quý 1 năm 2023 so với quý 1 năm 2022, và giảm bao nhiêu?
reference_answer: No, DLR's total operating expenses did not fall; they rose 17.8%, from $986,087 thousand in Q1 2022 to $1,161,389 thousand in Q1 2023.
evidence_quotes: Total operating expenses | 1,161,389 | 986,087

question_en: What kinds of business risks does Welltower highlight in the risk factor summary of its fiscal 2024 10-K?
question_vi: Welltower nêu những loại rủi ro kinh doanh nào trong phần tóm tắt các yếu tố rủi ro của báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2024?
reference_answer: Welltower's fiscal 2024 risk factor summary lists business risks including the ability of operators and tenants to make payments, investments in and acquisitions of healthcare and seniors housing properties, its joint venture partners, its ability to replace managers on a timely basis, and the impact of widespread illnesses or public health crises on occupancy.
evidence_quotes: • the ability of operators and tenants to make payments to us;
• investments in and acquisitions of healthcare and seniors housing properties;
• our joint venture partners;
• our ability to replace our managers on a timely and successful basis;
• the impacts of severe cold and flu seasons or other widespread illnesses or public health crises and government reaction thereto, on occupancy;

question_en: Who is MKC's partner in its Mexican joint venture, and what stake did MKC hold after its January 2026 deal?
question_vi: Đối tác của MKC trong liên doanh tại Mexico là ai, và MKC nắm giữ bao nhiêu phần sở hữu sau thương vụ hồi tháng 1 năm 2026?
reference_answer: Grupo Herdez is McCormick's partner in McCormick de Mexico, a joint venture formed in 1947. On January 2, 2026 McCormick completed the acquisition of an additional 25% interest from Grupo Herdez, increasing its ownership to 75%.
evidence_quotes: has completed the acquisition of an additional 25% ownership interest in McCormick de Mexico from Grupo Herdez, increasing its ownership to 75%.
a joint venture formed in 1947 with Grupo Herdez

question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 2 năm tài chính 2022 của STERIS (quý kết thúc ngày 30 tháng 9 năm 2021), công ty hướng nhà đầu tư đến đâu để xem chi tiết về các vụ kiện tụng?

of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended March 31, 2021, dated May 28, 2021.

question_en: How did BKR's liquidity discussion change between its fiscal 2021 and fiscal 2022 10-Ks, in terms of year-end cash and wording that was dropped?
question_vi: Phần thảo luận về thanh khoản của BKR thay đổi thế nào giữa 10-K năm tài chính 2021 và 2022, xét về tiền mặt cuối năm và những nội dung đã bị bỏ đi?
reference_answer: Cash and cash equivalents fell from $3.9 billion at December 31, 2021 (FY2021 10-K) to $2.5 billion at December 31, 2022 (FY2022 10-K). The FY2022 text also drops the FY2021 reference to COVID-19 pandemic dynamics and the statement that the next debt maturity is December 2023.
evidence_quotes: At December 31, 2021, we had cash and cash equivalents of $3.9 billion compared to $4.1 billion at December 31, 2020.
Despite the challenging dynamics that began in 2020 as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, we continue to maintain solid financial strength and liquidity.
Our next debt maturity is December 2023.
At December 31, 2022, we had cash and cash equivalents of $2.5 billion compared to $3.9 billion at December 31, 2021.

question_en: In its fiscal Q2 2022 10-Q, what borrowing capacity did Super Micro's Taiwanese arm secure from CTBC Bank in July 2021, and what interest does the revolving facility carry?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 2 năm tài chính 2022, chi nhánh Đài Loan của Super Micro đã có được hạn mức vay nào từ CTBC Bank vào tháng 7/2021, và khoản vay quay vòng chịu lãi suất bao nhiêu?
reference_answer: The 2021 CTBC Credit Lines, effective July 20, 2021, permit a term loan facility of up to NTD 1,550.0 million ($55.4 million) and a line of credit facility of up to $105.0 million. The 12-month revolving line covers up to 100% of eligible accounts receivable, up to $105.0 million, at the lender's USD interest rate plus 0.70% to 0.75% per annum, adjusted monthly.
evidence_quotes: permit borrowings, from time to time, pursuant to (i) a term loan facility of up to NTD 1,550.0 million ($55.4 million U.S. dollar equivalents)
(ii) a line of credit facility of up to $105.0 million (the “2021 CTBC Credit Facility”)

a 12-month revolving line of credit of up to 100% of eligible accounts receivable in an aggregate amount of up to $105.0 million with an interest rate equal to the lender's established USD interest rate plus 0.70% to 0.75% per annum which is adjusted monthly

question_en: Which items does Franklin Resources exclude when it computes adjusted net income for fiscal 2021?
question_vi: Franklin Resources loại trừ những khoản mục nào khi tính lợi nhuận ròng điều chỉnh cho năm tài chính 2021?
reference_answer: For fiscal 2021, Franklin Resources' adjusted net income excludes activities of CIPs, acquisition-related retention compensation, amortization and impairment of intangible assets, and special termination benefits related to workforce optimization initiatives, among other items.
evidence_quotes: • Activities of CIPs, including investment and other income (losses), net, and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests, net of revenues eliminated upon consolidation of investment products.
• Acquisition-related retention compensation.
• Amortization and impairment of intangible assets.
• Special termination benefits related to workforce optimization initiatives related to past acquisitions and specific initiatives announced by the Company.
